about_the_game:
An incest-themed visual novel series with animations, focusing on two sisters who live with their stepbrother and share experiences as they navigate college life away from home. 

GAME DESCRIPTION

Episode 9:

Emily convinces Lily to skip her usual cozy movie night and finally do something bold: get a tattoo.

Though Lily isn’t quite ready to make a permanent mark on her skin, she gets caught up in her sister’s wild plan.

As they make their way through a maze of back alleys and stop in front of a metal door covered in faded graffiti and old stickers, Lily starts to question everything…

But turning back might no longer be an option.

FEATURES

- HD renders and animations

- Video and image gallery
